design_reasoning_from_public_contract: The exact supplied interface is retained; the three local function exports and all supplied workflow helper/type reexports remain present. Type imports and the provider helper import preserve their original module identities; dependency implementations are neither read nor reconstructed.
Exact dispatch isolates local_agent, local_bash and local_workflow. Every other task type reaches the general formatter; local_dynamic_workflow is deliberately not treated as local_workflow.

Fresh local arrays project input without assigning to input or nested structures. String values use one original-string replacement pass; general/agent/workflow XML replaces five characters, while bash and provider multiline errors replace only three. Numeric interpolation retains native template conversion.

General tags are indented two spaces, general metrics four spaces; local tags are unindented. Optional string fields use the required truthy or !== undefined gate, and sections preserve reports-before-artifacts ordering and raw count/shown semantics.

General usage includes only present metrics in the required order and never falls back for total-tokens. Agent usage uses nullish total-token fallback, preserves zero and includes only its three metrics adjacent in one usage line. Falsey or empty usage is omitted.

Workflow status uses runStatus ?? status. Provider helper invocation is gated solely by failure?.providerStop !== undefined, forwards the supplied failure identity and taskId without copying, and allows synchronous exceptions to propagate. Undefined helper output falls back to the ordinary error.

Workflow guidance is appended only when requested, after one empty line. Its precedence is completed, then each recognized stopReason independently of the other status, then stopped, errored and generic fallback. Artifact presence uses !== undefined, and script path presence distinguishes undefined from an empty string.

Required guidance prose, XML/entity values and interpolated template fragments are preserved as source-derived public preservation material. Run IDs and script paths in guidance are inserted raw, including the file-aware error branch and model path suffix.

Non-bash final projections are truncated exactly once after the entire XML and guidance are joined. Native length/slice implement the 120000 UTF-16 code-unit boundary with the exact newline[truncated] suffix; there is no surrogate repair or closing-tag repair. Bash bypasses truncation.

Private helper names and decomposition were chosen by this author from the public contract. No original notification body was supplied or read, and no equivalence to a hidden original is claimed beyond the stated manual contract review.

manual_review_only.method: Read the complete initial and corrected authored body; reason manually from the six public inputs. No authored source, sample harness or compiler was executed.

Exact dispatch; required XML order/indentation; truthy optional fields versus empty-but-present result/error/stop-reason; full versus basic escaping.
Usage absence and zero preservation; agent nullish fallback; general metric order with no total-token fallback.
All guidance branch precedence and required paragraph order; artifact presence including count zero; missing versus empty script path; raw guidance substitutions.
Reports/artifacts missing versus present empty preview; shown attribute only when shown < count; provider output precedence/fallback.
Native UTF-16 boundary at 120000, overflow suffix, possible split surrogate, final-guidance truncation and bash exception.
manual_corrections: One same-author correction before handoff: remove an unnecessary double-quote escape in the five-character Unicode regular expression. Two complete source writes, not one, are accounted above.
